reason: PLACSP open data is an Atom feed of CODICE XML entries (https://contrataciondelestado.es/sindicacion/sindicacion_643/licitacionesPerfilesContratanteCompleto3.atom; re-checked 2026-09-25): one page is ~17 MB with ~490 full CODICE entries, there is no server-side filter or page size, and the next page is only an Atom <link href="…_20260923_211008.atom" rel="next"/> among several <link> elements (self, first, next, per-entry deeplinks). Remaining runtime gaps: (1) link-rel pagination — using the href of the <link> whose rel is "next" as the next request URL (cursor paths cannot select an array element by attribute value, and a cursor is sent as a query parameter, not used as the URL); (2) truncating an oversized feed page to `limit` before mapping. Monthly ZIP archives are the only other source.
